item.title: The Almanac 0.5.6
item.description:
• The opening animation now turns the line over into the mark like a ribbon, a little slower than before.
  • Packs are named the same everywhere (for example "CDC Travelers’ Health" in the library list and in answers), a pack the Almanac doesn't list is named and credited from its own details, and the example questions on a new chat show only for packs you can search, dimmed while a pack is still on its way.
  • While an answer loads, the mark now turns back and forth like the opening's ribbon, in place of its sparkle.
